§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 shipping vocabulary to advanced C1 maritime and logistics discourse, every module is anchored in real-world shipping scenarios — from freight forwarding to port operations, from vessel management to international trade regulation. Built for use inside shipping lines, freight forwarders, port authorities, and maritime logistics firms.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from port terminals, vessel bridges, and freight forwarding desks in 2026.

02

AI & automation

AI-powered route optimization, smart cargo tracking, and autonomous vessel technology run throughout the program — reflecting today's shipping industry.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

04

Case-led pedagogy

Mini case studies bring real shipping dilemmas — port congestion, cargo damage, regulatory disputes — into language learning.

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. Bateau reflects his vision: language learning as maritime capability — a multiplier of careers, cargo, and current.

Designed for the fleet operators, freight forwarders, and logistics leaders shaping global trade — Bateau is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to navigate in one of the world's oldest and most essential industries.
